questions.question:

C is sitting third right of D. E is sitting on the third right to F. B is sitting opposite A. D is sitting opposite E. C is sitting between A and E.

What is the position of F with respect to C?
questions.solution: Six employees: A, B, C, D, E and F. 1) E is sitting on the third right to F. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a66007667a43506569e0dfa93013c2e8e9e1484a7cc636be198582b34a836ca3.png] 2) D is sitting opposite E.

questions.question: B, I, J, T, A and D are sitting around a round table facing the centre. D is to the right of I who is opposite of T, B is not next to J, who is to the right of T. Who is to the left of A?
questions.solution:
Given: B, I, J, T, A and D are sitting around a round table facing the centre.

Hence, ‘J’ is to the left of A.

questions.question:

questions.question: Amit, Bablu, Ramesh, Deepak, Imran, Sunil, and Sanju are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre. Amit does not sit adjacent to Imran and Sanju. Here, 'Sunil' sits immediate right of Amit.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Sunil"**.

Clockwise means - Left of P. (There is only 1 person between P and J)
